text:
Sam B: Quick sync — I'm adding two new telemetry signals for continuous batching to the Console: batch_size_dist (histogram), queue_wait_ms (p50/p95), and node_saturation_pct. Need runtime + infra inputs for naming/labels and cardinality.
Priya K: +1. From runtime side we can emit per-shard metrics: batch_size and wait_time_ms per model, region, backend_type. Question: do we want per-model version label? That explodes cardinality.
Zhao L: On infra side, we can throttle cardinality by sampling 1% of requests or by only emitting histograms (buckets) aggregated at 1m. What's the dashboard use-case? Live troubleshooting or SLO monitoring?
Sam B: Both. For SLOs we need p99 wait_time, and for live we need fill-rate heatmaps and percent of batches hitting size target. UX: product wants per-route rollup and ability to drill to pool-level.
Anna P (DevEx): Important for rollout UX: devs need to know when a rollout increases batching wait. Can we expose per-release tag? maybe label route=... and rollout_id=... 
Priya K: We can add rollout_id label but would prefer it optional — will keep cardinality if used only in dev projects. Suggest default false and a flag to enable.
Zhao L: For ingest, infra can provide aggregated histograms keyed by route and pool only. Runtime will emit per-model-version when enabled. Also propose standard metric names and units.
Sam B: I'll draft a naming contract. Quick sketch:
```
redwood.batcher.batch_size_histogram{route, pool, model, region}
redwood.batcher.wait_time_ms{route, pool, quantile}
redwood.batcher.saturation_pct{pool, region}
```
Priya K: prefer wait_time_summary with p50/p90/p99 as separate metrics to avoid label explosion.
Anna P: For Console, we want bucketed histograms to render heatmaps. Can runtime emit fixed 8 buckets (0-5ms,5-10ms, ...)?
Priya K: Yes, runtime can emit 8 fixed buckets. We'll add a flag to switch to high-res buckets for dedicated customers.
Sam B: Action items:
- Sam: draft naming + ownership doc (by EOD)
- Priya: runtime telemetry contract + flag for model-version emission (Monday)
- Zhao: infra aggregator + sampling config (Monday)
- Anna: mockup Console panels for heatmap + rollout overlay (Wednesday)
DevEx Bot: @here Added tracker #TICKET-4567
Zhao L: One more — quota dashboards need a derived metric: avg_batch_fill_rate = avg(batch_size)/target_batch_size. infra can compute.
Priya K: runtime will emit target_batch_size label per pool.
Sam B: Great. If no objections, I'll post the PR with contract and proposed panels.
Anna P: :thumbsup:
Priya K: LGTM
Zhao L: fine
